methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Amca is a robotics and manufacturing company at the IPO stage, having raised $76.5M to date. The comparable universe consists of nine firms in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector: one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

The peer-median method was not applicable in this analysis. The sector contains eight same-sector comparables, but applying stage-specific filters (same-stage or adjacent-stage) and valuation-tier alignment yielded insufficient datapoints—fewer than the three required for a reliable median calculation. A broad all-sector median approach was deemed misleading given the heterogeneity in business models and maturity across the private robotics landscape.

The absence of a triangulated valuation range reflects material data constraints rather than analytical failure. With only one public comparable and a private cohort that lacks sufficient stage and scale alignment within the narrow peer set, traditional multiples-based approaches lack the precision needed for an IPO-stage company. Key uncertainties include: the revenue and EBITDA profile of the single public comparable relative to Amca's unit economics; the valuation multiples at which the five named private peers were most recently marked; and the specific capital efficiency and growth trajectory that distinguish Amca within the robotics segment. Resolution of these inputs would be essential before advancing to a valuation recommendation.
